title: Finnish famine of 1866–1868
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Finnish famine of 1866–1868", at revision 1370291450, opens: "The Finnish famine of 1866–1868 was the last famine in Finland, and the last major famine in Northern Europe." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1558846, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "the hunger years of Finland". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
